name: upgrade-prompt
title: Upgrade prompt
description: The wall a free user hits: what is locked, what the next plan unlocks, the price and a Not now that always works, with an optional usage meter.
docs: Pass the feature that is locked (the heading), the plan that unlocks it (a name, a price and what the price is for), what the plan adds as a list, onUpgrade and onDismiss. onDismiss is required on purpose: the panel has no way to hide itself, so there is always an exit, and calling it should show the free experience again, with focus moved to its heading, because the button that was pressed leaves with the panel. It is a labelled region, not a modal: focus is never trapped, nothing is dimmed behind it, and a screen reader hears Locked before the feature's name. description gives the two lines on what the feature does, compareHref adds the quieter Compare plans link, and usage (used, limit and a label) shows how much of the free allowance is gone as a meter with the numbers in words; once the allowance is used up the panel says so in a sentence with an icon, not in colour. A numeric price is written as money in the currency and locale you pass, with cents only when it has them. The panel needs no client JavaScript; a function passed to it needs a client component around it. labels translates every fixed word.
